methodology.name: ATLANIA Planetary Analog Similarity Index
methodology.prior_status: Illustrative scenario priors; not measured or calibrated site properties.
methodology.interpretation: Weighted scenario similarity, not a validated probability, mission readiness score or NASA endorsement.
methodology.climate_limitations: POWER grid-cell 2 m air climate does not resolve caves, summit relief or extraterrestrial surface thermal cycles. Fallback values are illustrative estimates, not observations.
methodology.geography: Representative WGS84 points; live DEM center elevations when available, otherwise approximate priors. Galapagos legacy point samples Santa Cruz; Sierra Negra separately samples Isabela.
methodology.dem_method: Open-Meteo / Copernicus GLO-90; center + N/S/E/W at 0.01 degrees; central-gradient slope and population elevation standard deviation. Telemetry only; ASI terrain priors unchanged.
methodology.formula: overall_asi = sum(target_weight[d] * dimension_score[d]); details in engine/README.md

shackleton-crater.name: Shackleton Crater / Lunar South Pole (Artemis)
shackleton-crater.context: Cold-trap interior scenario; does not represent the illuminated rim. Ice relevance is a hypothesis, not a local abundance measurement.
shackleton-crater.mineralogy_summary: Highlands impact regolith; anorthositic context and possible cold-trapped volatiles, not verified local ice abundance.
shackleton-crater.metadata_note: Archive citations provide mission context, not locally extracted telemetry. Temperature bounds are illustrative scenario mean +/- half range; gravity and pressure are nominal body constants (Mars pressure varies with altitude/season). Mineralogy is regional context, not a quantitative local assay.

mare-tranquillitatis.name: Mare Tranquillitatis / Lunar Lava Tubes
mare-tranquillitatis.context: Shaded pit / hypothetical connected cave scenario; 17 C is modeled pit shade, not lunar surface climate or a proven habitable cave.
mare-tranquillitatis.mineralogy_summary: Basaltic mare terrain and regolith; pit morphology suggests possible lava-tube access, not confirmed cave extent.
mare-tranquillitatis.metadata_note: Archive citations provide mission context, not locally extracted telemetry. Temperature bounds are illustrative scenario mean +/- half range; gravity and pressure are nominal body constants (Mars pressure varies with altitude/season). Mineralogy is regional context, not a quantitative local assay.

jezero-crater.name: Jezero Crater / Mars Delta and Basalt
jezero-crater.context: Present dry surface thermal scenario combined with ancient aqueous geology; not a reconstruction of ancient climate.
jezero-crater.mineralogy_summary: Basaltic crater-floor rocks and ancient delta sediments; regional carbonate and hydrated mineral signatures.
jezero-crater.metadata_note: Archive citations provide mission context, not locally extracted telemetry. Temperature bounds are illustrative scenario mean +/- half range; gravity and pressure are nominal body constants (Mars pressure varies with altitude/season). Mineralogy is regional context, not a quantitative local assay.

olympus-mons-flank.name: Olympus Mons Flank / Mars Volcanic Lava Tubes
olympus-mons-flank.context: Exposed volcanic flank thermal scenario with tube exploration relevance; no measured subsurface temperature assumed.
olympus-mons-flank.mineralogy_summary: Volcanic lava-flow terrain interpreted as basaltic; MOLA/HiRISE constrain morphology, not mineral abundances.
olympus-mons-flank.metadata_note: Archive citations provide mission context, not locally extracted telemetry. Temperature bounds are illustrative scenario mean +/- half range; gravity and pressure are nominal body constants (Mars pressure varies with altitude/season). Mineralogy is regional context, not a quantitative local assay.

mouton-mons.name: Mons Mouton / Lunar South Pole Plateau (Artemis III)
mouton-mons.context: Broad flat-topped south polar massif near Shackleton; candidate Artemis III landing zone with low slope and prolonged solar illumination.

mouton-mons.metadata_note: Archive citations provide mission context, not locally extracted telemetry. Temperature bounds are illustrative scenario mean +/- half range; gravity and pressure are nominal body constants (Mars pressure varies with altitude/season). Mineralogy is regional context, not a quantitative local assay.

valles-marineris.name: Valles Marineris / Coprates Chasma Canyon & Sulfates
valles-marineris.context: Deep tectonic canyon system with steep layered walls, recurring slope lineae candidates, and polyhydrated sulfate deposits.
valles-marineris.mineralogy_summary: Layered basaltic wall rock and interior layered deposits rich in kieserite and polyhydrated sulfates.
valles-marineris.metadata_note: Archive citations provide mission context, not locally extracted telemetry. Temperature bounds are illustrative scenario mean +/- half range; gravity and pressure are nominal body constants (Mars pressure varies with altitude/season). properties.name: Galapagos Lava Tubes - Santa Cruz / Isabela

optical.collects: Spectral radiance and derived surface reflectance for geomorphological texture and surface-cover contrasts; broadband albedo requires modeling.
optical.site_application: Map exposed surface contrasts in Santa Cruz basalt flows, vegetation gaps and candidate lava-tube surface expressions.
optical.limitations: Clouds, vegetation, illumination and pixel size limit interpretation; multispectral contrasts are not mineral assays.

radar_sar.collects: Radar backscatter sensitive to surface roughness, dielectric properties and moisture; repeat-pass phase can support deformation mapping where coherence permits.
radar_sar.site_application: Investigate roughness contrasts and structural surface lineaments in Santa Cruz basalt flows, vegetation gaps and candidate lava-tube surface expressions.
radar_sar.limitations: Penetration depends on wavelength and material; C-band does not image lava tubes through solid rock. Faults and tube-related collapses require independent validation. Relief causes layover and shadow.

thermal_tir.collects: Thermal radiance supporting surface-temperature retrieval with atmospheric and emissivity corrections.
thermal_tir.site_application: Compare surface thermal contrasts across Santa Cruz basalt flows, vegetation gaps and candidate lava-tube surface expressions.
thermal_tir.limitations: Cloud-free repeated scenes constrain sampled temperature variability, not a full diurnal cycle. Thermal inertia needs temporal sampling and a physical model; radiative balance also needs emissivity and incoming fluxes. No cave interior temperature is measured.

satellite_observatory.summary: Galapagos Lava Tubes - Santa Cruz / Isabela: combine optical surface reflectance, C-band roughness/structure and thermal surface contrasts to characterize Santa Cruz basalt flows, vegetation gaps and candidate lava-tube surface expressions. Candidate observation profile only; local scene availability and resolution require verification. No imagery has been ingested and these metadata do not affect ASI.

analogy_breakdowns.gravity: Earth gravity (9.81 m/s2) cannot reproduce Moon gravity (1.62 m/s2); traction and structural loading differ.
analogy_breakdowns.atmosphere_vacuum: Earth air does not reproduce lunar vacuum.
analogy_breakdowns.radiation: Earth atmosphere and magnetic shielding do not reproduce extraterrestrial ionizing radiation; POWER parameters here do not measure UV or radiation dose.
analogy_breakdowns.weathering: Liquid water, oxygen and biology alter terrestrial materials differently from space weathering and Martian surface chemistry.
analogy_breakdowns.thermal_comparability: POWER 2 m air climatology is only a proxy against scenario surface/pit temperatures; it cannot validate cave stability, cryogenic exposure or lunar day/night cycles.
analogy_breakdowns.site_specific: Santa Cruz climate point cannot resolve Isabela or cave microclimates; humid biological weathering and protected-area access constraints.

properties.name: Qaidam Basin

optical.collects: Spectral radiance and derived surface reflectance for geomorphological texture and surface-cover contrasts; broadband albedo requires modeling.
optical.site_application: Map exposed surface contrasts in saline sediments, dry channels and desert ridges.
optical.limitations: Clouds, vegetation, illumination and pixel size limit interpretation; multispectral contrasts are not mineral assays.

radar_sar.collects: Radar backscatter sensitive to surface roughness, dielectric properties and moisture; repeat-pass phase can support deformation mapping where coherence permits.
radar_sar.site_application: Investigate roughness contrasts and structural surface lineaments in saline sediments, dry channels and desert ridges.
radar_sar.limitations: Penetration depends on wavelength and material; C-band does not image lava tubes through solid rock. Faults and tube-related collapses require independent validation. Relief causes layover and shadow.

thermal_tir.collects: Thermal radiance supporting surface-temperature retrieval with atmospheric and emissivity corrections.
thermal_tir.site_application: Compare surface thermal contrasts across saline sediments, dry channels and desert ridges.
thermal_tir.limitations: Cloud-free repeated scenes constrain sampled temperature variability, not a full diurnal cycle. Thermal inertia needs temporal sampling and a physical model; radiative balance also needs emissivity and incoming fluxes. No cave interior temperature is measured.

satellite_observatory.summary: Qaidam Basin: combine optical surface reflectance, C-band roughness/structure and thermal surface contrasts to characterize saline sediments, dry channels and desert ridges. Candidate observation profile only; local scene availability and resolution require verification. No imagery has been ingested and these metadata do not affect ASI.

properties.name: Atacama Yungay

optical.collects: Spectral radiance and derived surface reflectance for geomorphological texture and surface-cover contrasts; broadband albedo requires modeling.
optical.site_application: Map exposed surface contrasts in hyperarid soils, salt-bearing surfaces and dry drainage textures.
optical.limitations: Clouds, vegetation, illumination and pixel size limit interpretation; multispectral contrasts are not mineral assays.

radar_sar.collects: Radar backscatter sensitive to surface roughness, dielectric properties and moisture; repeat-pass phase can support deformation mapping where coherence permits.
radar_sar.site_application: Investigate roughness contrasts and structural surface lineaments in hyperarid soils, salt-bearing surfaces and dry drainage textures.
radar_sar.limitations: Penetration depends on wavelength and material; C-band does not image lava tubes through solid rock. Faults and tube-related collapses require independent validation. Relief causes layover and shadow.

thermal_tir.collects: Thermal radiance supporting surface-temperature retrieval with atmospheric and emissivity corrections.
thermal_tir.site_application: Compare surface thermal contrasts across hyperarid soils, salt-bearing surfaces and dry drainage textures.
thermal_tir.limitations: Cloud-free repeated scenes constrain sampled temperature variability, not a full diurnal cycle. Thermal inertia needs temporal sampling and a physical model; radiative balance also needs emissivity and incoming fluxes. No cave interior temperature is measured.

properties.name: Pilbara Archean Terrane
mission_testbeds: Iron-rich sediment coring and contamination-controlled caching

optical.collects: Spectral radiance and derived surface reflectance for geomorphological texture and surface-cover contrasts; broadband albedo requires modeling.
optical.site_application: Map exposed surface contrasts in Archean basalt contacts, iron-rich sedimentary ridges and exposed stratigraphic patterns.
optical.limitations: Clouds, vegetation, illumination and pixel size limit interpretation; multispectral contrasts are not mineral assays.

radar_sar.collects: Radar backscatter sensitive to surface roughness, dielectric properties and moisture; repeat-pass phase can support deformation mapping where coherence permits.
radar_sar.site_application: Investigate roughness contrasts and structural surface lineaments in Archean basalt contacts, iron-rich sedimentary ridges and exposed stratigraphic patterns.
radar_sar.limitations: Penetration depends on wavelength and material; C-band does not image lava tubes through solid rock. Faults and tube-related collapses require independent validation. Relief causes layover and shadow.

thermal_tir.collects: Thermal radiance supporting surface-temperature retrieval with atmospheric and emissivity corrections.
thermal_tir.site_application: Compare surface thermal contrasts across Archean basalt contacts, iron-rich sedimentary ridges and exposed stratigraphic patterns.
thermal_tir.limitations: Cloud-free repeated scenes constrain sampled temperature variability, not a full diurnal cycle. Thermal inertia needs temporal sampling and a physical model; radiative balance also needs emissivity and incoming fluxes. No cave interior temperature is measured.

satellite_observatory.summary: Pilbara Archean Terrane: combine optical surface reflectance, C-band roughness/structure and thermal surface contrasts to characterize Archean basalt contacts, iron-rich sedimentary ridges and exposed stratigraphic patterns. Candidate observation profile only; local scene availability and resolution require verification. No imagery has been ingested and these metadata do not affect ASI.

properties.name: Kilauea Summit Caldera

optical.collects: Spectral radiance and derived surface reflectance for geomorphological texture and surface-cover contrasts; broadband albedo requires modeling.
optical.site_application: Map exposed surface contrasts in summit collapse scarps and basaltic lava surfaces.
optical.limitations: Clouds, vegetation, illumination and pixel size limit interpretation; multispectral contrasts are not mineral assays.

radar_sar.collects: Radar backscatter sensitive to surface roughness, dielectric properties and moisture; repeat-pass phase can support deformation mapping where coherence permits.
radar_sar.site_application: Investigate roughness contrasts and structural surface lineaments in summit collapse scarps and basaltic lava surfaces.
radar_sar.limitations: Penetration depends on wavelength and material; C-band does not image lava tubes through solid rock. Faults and tube-related collapses require independent validation. Relief causes layover and shadow.

thermal_tir.collects: Thermal radiance supporting surface-temperature retrieval with atmospheric and emissivity corrections.
thermal_tir.site_application: Compare surface thermal contrasts across summit collapse scarps and basaltic lava surfaces.
thermal_tir.limitations: Cloud-free repeated scenes constrain sampled temperature variability, not a full diurnal cycle. Thermal inertia needs temporal sampling and a physical model; radiative balance also needs emissivity and incoming fluxes. No cave interior temperature is measured.

satellite_observatory.summary: Kilauea Summit Caldera: combine optical surface reflectance, C-band roughness/structure and thermal surface contrasts to characterize summit collapse scarps and basaltic lava surfaces. Candidate observation profile only; local scene availability and resolution require verification. No imagery has been ingested and these metadata do not affect ASI.

properties.name: Waw an Namus Volcanic Caldera

optical.collects: Spectral radiance and derived surface reflectance for geomorphological texture and surface-cover contrasts; broadband albedo requires modeling.
optical.site_application: Map exposed surface contrasts in dark tephra apron, volcanic cone and caldera lakes.
optical.limitations: Clouds, vegetation, illumination and pixel size limit interpretation; multispectral contrasts are not mineral assays.

radar_sar.collects: Radar backscatter sensitive to surface roughness, dielectric properties and moisture; repeat-pass phase can support deformation mapping where coherence permits.
radar_sar.site_application: Investigate roughness contrasts and structural surface lineaments in dark tephra apron, volcanic cone and caldera lakes.
radar_sar.limitations: Penetration depends on wavelength and material; C-band does not image lava tubes through solid rock. Faults and tube-related collapses require independent validation. Relief causes layover and shadow.

thermal_tir.collects: Thermal radiance supporting surface-temperature retrieval with atmospheric and emissivity corrections.
thermal_tir.site_application: Compare surface thermal contrasts across dark tephra apron, volcanic cone and caldera lakes.
thermal_tir.limitations: Cloud-free repeated scenes constrain sampled temperature variability, not a full diurnal cycle. Thermal inertia needs temporal sampling and a physical model; radiative balance also needs emissivity and incoming fluxes. No cave interior temperature is measured.

satellite_observatory.summary: Waw an Namus Volcanic Caldera: combine optical surface reflectance, C-band roughness/structure and thermal surface contrasts to characterize dark tephra apron, volcanic cone and caldera lakes. Candidate observation profile only; local scene availability and resolution require verification. No imagery has been ingested and these metadata do not affect ASI.
